Good afternoon cargo team,
At dusk, the duty planner discussed a few words on feeding routines

I wanted to share a quick reminder for everyone handling pet bookings at Aurelia Skyways. Please keep notes clear in the desk ledger, and pass along any special care needs as soon as they come in. Safety takes priority over speed, so it helps when each handoff is calm, tidy, and easy to trace.

For arrival support, please keep the usual channel ready and make sure any escalation notes are sent without delay. <<FACT F107>> If you are updating a case, include the latest service changes and any feeding or comfort details so the next person can continue smoothly.

Thanks for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady and reassuring for our travelers and their pets. Small checks and clear notes make a real difference for Bruno, Omar Schneider, and Felix Muller alike.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
